verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a separate test environment for testing the full client-side and server-side integration before going live, and says transactions can be tested with test credentials. A TEST environment flag (MCP server) and test base URLs (Product Feed API) also appear. The evidence never shows test card numbers, simulating declines, or testing disputes or chargebacks, and never says the test environment mirrors production. missing for 10: documented test card numbers for each scenario, decline simulation in test mode, dispute/chargeback testing, explicit test/production parity, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: We recommend testing your full integration, including the client-side and server-side parts, in your test environment before accepting live payments.
Test the different types of transactions with Adyen that your integration handles using test credentials.
